subject.title: Ollama local provider: native tool_calls not recognized, falls back to unreliable JSON-text parsing

question: Should this issue wait for a live Ollama trace before a fix PR is queued, or should maintainers sponsor an investigation from the current report alone?
rationale: Current source already implements native `tool_calls` and the report may involve documented `/v1` behavior, so automation cannot safely choose a code change without maintainer acceptance of the remaining proof gap.

options.title: Require live trace first
options.body: Ask for or capture the active `api`/`baseUrl`, generated `/api/chat` body, and raw NDJSON response before choosing a fix boundary.

options.title: Sponsor provider investigation now
options.body: A maintainer can treat the report as enough signal to investigate Ollama request shaping and stream normalization manually.

options.title: Close only after config proof
options.body: Close as documented `/v1` behavior only if the active runtime config proves the issue never used native `api: "ollama"`.

recommendation.title: Require live trace first
recommendation.body: Ask for or capture the active `api`/`baseUrl`, generated `/api/chat` body, and raw NDJSON response before choosing a fix boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the native Ollama provider path and has recent adjacent local-model work, making them the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency call.
